name: Deal tracker
job: Deals that move when the conversation does
intro: Deal tracker keeps your pipeline current from what was actually said in mail and meetings. Every change waits for a person, with the sentence it came from, and the weekly review writes itself.
does: Proposes new deals, stage moves, amounts and close dates from what was said.
Never changes a deal on its own: you keep, change or dismiss each proposal.
Writes the weekly review: what moved, what is closing, what went quiet.
setup: Name your stages, each with what reaching it means.
Bring in the deals you have: paste a spreadsheet, or find them in your last 30 days of mail and meeting notes.
Review what it found, each with its sentence.
Pick the day and time for the weekly review.
